name: nestari
description: Trust-based boarding house discovery and management platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nestari/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @nestari/api" "npm run dev -w @nestari/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nestari/shared && npm run build -w @nestari/api && npm run build -w @nestari/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @nestari/shared && npm run typecheck -w @nestari/api && npm run typecheck -w @nestari/web
